beni_2024.journal: Journal for General Philosophy of Science
beni_2024.role: Structural-realist warrant from formal continuity and unity across thermodynamics, information theory, and FEP.
beni_2024.m27_delta: DR does not challenge this structural-realist warrant; it becomes relevant when a represented equality is promoted into kind or capacity individuation evidence.

beni_2026.role: Combines structural invariance with natural-kind reasoning in consciousness science.
beni_2026.m27_delta: Natural-kind constraints can satisfy DR by restricting a crossing preservation fiber or showing discarded distinctions irrelevant to kind membership.

north_2026.role: Objective or non-pragmatic perspicuity of representations.
north_2026.m27_delta: DR adds target-indexing: objective perspicuity for one scientific aim does not automatically make the induced equality diagnostic under an independently declared capacity criterion C.

brousalis_2026.role: Comparative methodology centered on epistemically relevant similarities and differences.
brousalis_2026.m27_delta: DR is an input-qualification rule before comparative weighting: provenance qualification -> diagnostic relevance -> comparative weighting.
